jurisdiction_warning.message: Do NOT assume every Bengaluru PIN code maps to the same Rent Controller / Rent Court forum. The applicable Rent Controller, Assistant Commissioner / Sub-Divisional Magistrate, and Court of Small Causes jurisdiction depend on the property location, the relevant government notification, and the statutory threshold under the Karnataka Rent Act. Section 49 provides for an application to the Controller, but the applicable territorial jurisdiction, current designation and filing address must be verified from the relevant Karnataka DPAL / Revenue Department gazette.
jurisdiction_warning.action: For emergency utility restoration or unauthorized lock-outs, use verified DLSA (legal-aid) referral and Police 112 for immediate safety. Rent Controller filing details must be verified per PIN and jurisdiction before inclusion in any production directory.
